title: AI agent crawlers now need permission. Here’s how to get it
summary: Cloudflare announced that AI agent crawlers will be blocked by default on participating websites starting September 15, shifting from open web crawling to a permission-based model. Website owners will need to explicitly allow AI agents access to their content, giving them more control over how their data is used by AI systems.
problem_solved: Addresses the issue of AI agents freely crawling websites without website owner consent, raising copyright and data usage concerns.
why_valuable: Provides website owners with granular control over AI agent access to their content, establishing a permission-based framework that balances AI utility with content creator rights.
